verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਫਲ ਹੋਤ ਸਮੈ ਪਾਇ ਸਰਬਦਾ ਫਲੰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਫਲ ਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise aan birakh safal hot samai pai sarabadhaa fala(n)te sadhaa fal su savaiaadh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tree bears fruit at a certain time of the year, but there are some trees which bear fruit all the time (like Kalap Variksh) and their fruit is very tasty too.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਪ ਜਲ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਹੈ ਜਤਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise koop jal nikasat hai jatan ke'ee ga(n)gaa jal mukat pravaeh prasaadh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as drawing water from the well demands some effort, but the flow of water in river Ganges is continuous and in plenty.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੂਲ ਤੇਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪੈ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mritakaa agan tool tel mil dheep dhipai jagamag jot saseear bisamaadh hai ||

en.bdb: Just as the combination of an earthen lamp, oil, cotton and fire results in a light-giving lamp that spreads its radiance in a limited place, but the radiance of the moon shines in the whole world and spreads strange happiness all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੀਏ ਫਲੁ ਦੇਤ ਜੇਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise aan dhev sev ke'ee fal dhet jet satigur dharas na saasan jamaadh hai ||456||

en.bdb: Similarly, whatever quantum of devoted service one performs for a god, one receives reward accordingly. But a vision of the True teacher dispels the fear of angels of death beside blessing I one with many other goods. (456)
